purpose: Higher-budget, three-seed numerical confirmation for the canonical UMMU C5G7 reference arrangement only.

planning_rationale.caveat: This is a budget-planning estimate only. It is not a guarantee of convergence or of meeting the 10 pcm screen.

required_diagnostics: batch-wise k-generation and Shannon entropy traces
assembly fission-rate proxy extraction with uncertainty caveat
aggregate numerical screen and explicit non-certification status

decision_policy.if_numerical_screen_passes: Record the scalar screen as passed, but keep full benchmark validation blocked until primary-specification review and benchmark-compatible spatial tally comparison are independently completed.
decision_policy.if_numerical_screen_fails: Report the failed criterion and diagnose model identity, source convergence, and Monte Carlo uncertainty before deciding whether another run or model correction is justified.
never: Do not call this reactor-safety certification.
Do not choose a material-placement winner from the canonical run.
Do not infer physical convergence from a scalar k-effective match alone.
